generationPrompts.Prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original transparent character portrait for a Chinese xianxia cultivation RPG, replacement of the Xuandao Sect character. Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, not edit targets: preserve the refined, expressive painterly face, fine dark hair strands, silk and ink-wash brushwork of the Lihuo reference, but CHANGE all red/fire clothing to Xuandao's quiet dark teal, pale moon-white, and restrained antique gold. The previous Xuandao reference is only a sect-color guide; improve its stiff ceremonial silhouette into a graceful immortal cultivator. Original Chinese fantasy 2D game painting, realistic yet poetic adult face, soft ink edges, airy translucent silk sleeves, beautiful natural anatomy and delicate hands. A readable warm, serene immortal presence, not cold armored royalty. Subtle five-element sword cultivation is shown by an elegant sheathed long sword and five tiny near-monochrome pale-gold sword glints close to the shoulder, NEVER a rainbow ring. Do not use a giant compass, orbiting machinery, chunky shoulder armor, heavy geometric plates, red garments, enormous multicolored effects, anime cel shading or photoreal photography. Tall 2:3 portrait, single full figure head to boots, subject centered and fills about 90% of height, flowing sleeves and all hair/jewelry entirely within frame with a small clear margin; no cropped extremities. Actual transparent background with clean preserved alpha, no scenery, no rectangular fog/gradient, no floor, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no border. Subject: a handsome adult East Asian male immortal swordsman, refined gentle strong-browed face and intelligent relaxed eyes, long black hair loosely half-tied with a slim pale-jade hairpin instead of a towering crown, a few soft loose locks. Long moon-white inner hanfu and flowing deep teal outer robe with only delicate pale-gold cloud and sword embroidery; narrow jade belt, light ribbon ties flutter in a natural breeze. Calm graceful three-quarter pose, one hand gently holds the sword hilt near the hip and the other makes a subtle two-finger guiding gesture near the waist, relaxed shoulders, asymmetrical drifting sleeve and hem rhythm. Masculine, elegant, quietly powerful, the clean silhouette and face have priority over ornaments.
